ops.h: Shock by extremity temperature and JVP (Blackbook)
ops.html: Potentially acutely life-threatening presentation

Shock types, JVP and causes (Blackbook)
  • Warm extremities → Distributive shock (Low JVP): Sepsis; Anaphylaxis; Burns; Neurogenic
  • Cold extremities
    • High JVP
      • Cardiogenic shock (bibasilar lung crackles): Myocardial Ischemia or Infarction; Left-sided Valvular Disease; Arrhythmia; Cardiomyopathy (ie. HOCM)
      • Obstructive shock (normal/decreased breath sounds): Pulmonary Embolism; Tension Pneumothorax; Cardiac Tamponade
    • Low JVP
      • Hypovolemic shock (rule out decompensated distributive shock): Hemorrhage; Dehydration; Vomiting; Diarrhea; Interstitial Fluid Redistribution
